checkout.policyConsent: I agree to the order and protection policy and acknowledge the privacy policy. This is a prepaid customized order. Eligible wrong, damaged, defective or missing-item claims remain subject to the protection policy and applicable rights.

policy.title: Know the important details before you order.
policy.lead: Payment, customization, packing, delivery and issue-protection terms are shown clearly so you know what to expect.

cards.title: Payment
cards.body: Orders are prepaid. Gateway payments are confirmed from the payment provider/server status. Manual UPI, when available, may require a transaction reference for verification. Order processing starts only after payment is verified.

cards.title: Customized orders
cards.body: Personalized or custom hampers are prepared to your instructions, so change-of-mind cancellation or return eligibility may be limited. This does not affect rights that cannot legally be excluded.

cards.title: Wrong / damaged / defective / missing
cards.body: Eligible verified issues can be reviewed for refund, replacement or another appropriate resolution. Relevant photos, video, packaging or other proof may be requested where reasonably needed.

cards.title: Packing video
cards.body: Where the packing-video feature is available for your order, a video of the finished hamper is shared before dispatch for review.

cards.title: Product substitutions
cards.body: If a material substitution is needed because of stock, size or presentation constraints, we’ll seek confirmation before making that major change.

cards.title: Requested delivery date
cards.body: The date you select is your requested delivery-by date. Feasibility depends on preparation time, pincode and courier serviceability, and is not guaranteed until confirmed.

seo.title: Celebration | Custom Gift Hampers

issues.title: Something wrong with your order?
issues.body: Report a wrong, damaged, defective or missing item here. Our team will review the issue and help with the eligible resolution.
issues.submitted: Issue received. Our team will review it.
